fact: A TTCL data centre IT specialist said at the Nanenane fair in Dodoma that the TTCL Data Centre (National Internet Data Centre, NIDC) has reached the international Tier III standard and offers cloud and storage services to the public and institutions.
title: TTCL: UHIFADHI WA TAARIFA NDANI YA NCHI UIMARISHA USALAMA KIDIGITALI
